headline: Steel lifts operating profit while per-share earnings fall
summary_short: Revenue was KRW 19.14T (+10.9% y/y) and operating profit KRW 945B (+47.9% y/y); EPS was KRW 3,150, down 43.4% y/y.
summary_long: EPS of KRW 3,150 fell 65.2% q/q and 43.4% y/y on the shard. News reports of the results put revenue at KRW 19.14T and operating profit at KRW 945B. Reports attribute the gain to steel, while battery materials swung to an operating loss. Net profit figures differ across sources. Guidance is not assessed.
confidence_notes: primary filing unreachable — KPI-only summary — no filing was read; drivers and guidance not assessed. Revenue and operating profit come from Korean news reports. Net profit is reported inconsistently (KRW 760B vs KRW 380B) so it is omitted. EPS is Yahoo data.
